decisions.reason: As a newly launched digital extension very close to the core practice software, it supports the firm's strategic move toward connected workflows and a growing firm with R&D and some slack would normally keep it while early results are still uncertain.

Although somewhat less central than software itself, the education institute builds on existing training capabilities and customer relationships, so without clear signs of performance below aspiration management would be inclined to retain it for at least another year.

The remote screen sharing support tool fits the firm's established support offer and can strengthen service quality for dental practices, making continuation more likely than withdrawal in a period of firm growth and ongoing search around the core business.
